changesRequestedReviews.body: Blocking until the failing test and the inline notes are addressed.

instructions: Triage `## Failing checks`. Playbook: "CI failure triage".
Journal key decisions or rejections with URLs or IDs: `pr-shepherd apply journal https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 '- <decision>'`

Set `$DISMISS_MESSAGE` to a one-line outcome; run even if no code changed: `pr-shepherd apply review https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 --reply-thread-ids PRRT_multi --message "$DISMISS_MESSAGE" --require-sha HEAD`
